(Netra)nārāyaṇa
title of Āḷvāñceri Tamprākkal of Kauṣītaki Śākhā of Ṛgvedins, the spiritual head of Kerala Brahmins; there have been several patrons of literature in this family.

(Netā)Rāmakṛṣṇa_Bhaṭṭa
disciple of Giridhara.
--Bhāgavatasiddhāntavijayavāda. śud. adv. See under the text.
--C. Prakāśa on Śuddhādvaitamārtāṇḍa of Giridhara. Some mss. ascr. the text to [Page063-b] Rāmakṛṣṇa. RASB.

. Vidyavilasa Press, Benares, 1906. (2)N.S. Press, Bombay, 1920.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 319. 850; also IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 2081. 2634.
--C. Prakāśa on Śrutirahasya of Giridhara. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 120. Bomb. Uni. Velankar 1102.
